children: Petco Health & Wellness Company, Inc. reported second-quarter results for the period ended Aug 1, 2026, with revenue essentially flat at $1.489B and diluted earnings per share of $0.13, while net income attributable to Class A and B-1 stockholders rose to $38.7M compared with $14M a year earlier.
Revenue was $1.489B for the quarter ended Aug 1, 2026, essentially flat vs $1.489B in the year-ago quarter (0.0% YoY).
Net income attributable to Class A and B-1 stockholders was $38.7M for the quarter ended Aug 1, 2026, vs $14.0M in the year-ago quarter (increase of $24.7M YoY).
Diluted earnings per share was $0.13 for the quarter ended Aug 1, 2026, up from $0.05 in the year-ago quarter (160% YoY).
Net sales were essentially flat year-over-year at $1.49B for the 13-week period and $2.99B for the 26-week period, with modest comparable sales growth of 0.6%.
Services continued to expand, up 3.6% in the 13-week period and 5.2% year-to-date, while supplies and companion animal product sales declined about 2%.
A membership relaunch produced stronger-than-expected response that caused a temporary sales disruption but is expected to support long-term customer retention.
Gross margin improved to 39.7% from 39.3%, aided by tariff refunds and inventory/unit-cost management; the company emphasized pricing and promotion discipline.
Petco operates about 1,377 U.S. pet care centers and is investing in vet and services optimization along with digital integration via Petco.com and its app.
